description.zh:
专有宿主机的自动释放时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

- 必须晚于当前时间起算的半小时及以后。
- 必须早于当前时间起算的三年及以前。
- 如果参数值中的秒（ss）不是00，则自动取为00。
- 如果不输入`AutoReleaseTime`参数，表示取消自动释放，专有宿主机在预约时间点不再自动释放。
description.en:
The automatic release time of the dedicated host. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.

- The automatic release time must be at least 30 minutes later than the current time.

- The automatic release time can be up to 3 years earlier than the current time.

- If the value of the seconds (ss) is not 00, it is automatically set to 00.

- If `AutoReleaseTime` is not configured, the automatic release feature is disabled, and the dedicated host will not be automatically released.

description.zh: 需要自动释放的专有宿主机ID。
description.en: The ID of the dedicated host.

description.zh: 专有宿主机所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the dedicated host. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 为专有宿主机设定自动释放时间

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
到达设置的自动释放时间后，按量付费专有宿主机会被自动释放。请确保您已经不再使用该宿主机，并已按需备份应用数据。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

A pay-as-you-go dedicated host can be automatically released at the specified time. Before you release a pay-as-you-go dedicated host, make sure that the host is no longer required and all necessary application data is backed up.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-dedicated-host-auto-release-time --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-id dh-bp165p6xk2tlw61e0000 --auto-release-time 2019-06-04T13:35:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
